# Experiment templates

Copied from the Ship48 factory templates (copies, not links: this repository is private and must not depend on the public factory repository). Copy a template into `experiments/<id>/` or `docs/` and fill it in.

| Template | Fill in as |
|---|---|
| `TASK_BREAKDOWN_TEMPLATE.md` | `docs/TASKS.md`, then task issues |
| `USER_JOURNEY_TEMPLATE.md` | `docs/JOURNEYS.md` |
| `ANALYTICS_SPEC_TEMPLATE.md` | `docs/ANALYTICS.md` |
| `COST_LOG_TEMPLATE.md` | `experiments/<id>/COST_LOG.md` |
| `HOUR_24_DECISION_TEMPLATE.md` | `experiments/<id>/HOUR_24.md` |
| `HOUR_48_DECISION_TEMPLATE.md` | `experiments/<id>/HOUR_48.md` |

The PRD template is already in place at `docs/PRD.md`; the market research template is in `docs/research/`.

Hour-48 final verdict: **BUILD, PIVOT, KILL or INCONCLUSIVE**. Write `NOT MEASURED` instead of estimating a metric.
